Definition: adverb from G2756; vainly, i.e. to no purpose:--in vain.
BiblicalUsage: Kenos means in vain, to no purpose. James 4:5 asks, do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, the spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Scripture never speaks in vain, so when it warns about envy, I had better listen.
